title: Write plans, designs and approvals
responsibility: Adapts desktop planning requests into stored plans, design versions, image threads and approvals.

inputs.name: planningWrites.context
inputs.description: The planning context: api.createPlan writes the new plan, and root is the repository that a plan record's design prompts and notes are read from.

inputs.name: planningWrites.draft
inputs.description: The plan's category (a desktop category such as functions or components), title, goal and optional proposed contract, whose error names must be unique. The title must give a nonempty slug of at most 64 characters; the planning package also refuses a slug that does not start with a letter, and the apis and models categories, which have no plan category.

examples.title: Planning writes
examples.goal: Adapts desktop planning requests into stored plans.

examples.title: Evidence grid
examples.goal: Shows the recorded captures of a unit side by side.

inputs.name: ensurePlan.context
inputs.description: The planning context: api lists the plans and reads or creates the unit's plan, and root is the repository that a plan record's design prompts and notes are read from.

inputs.name: ensurePlan.unit
inputs.description: The unit definition: when no plan exists for its id, the new plan takes the unit's id, title, responsibility, inputs and outputs, and only the names of its errors. Its kind is the plan category, with shared-function mapped to function; any other kind must be one of page, shell, layout, component, function, config or service, or the planning package refuses it.

examples.title: Write plans, designs and approvals
examples.responsibility: Adapts desktop planning requests into stored plans, design versions, image threads and approvals.

inputs.name: addPlanDesign.context
inputs.description: The planning context: api reads the plan and adds the design, and root is the repository that the added design's prompt and notes are read back from.

inputs.name: addPlanDesign.draft
inputs.description: The design to add: its prompt, generator, baseRevision and either one complete PNG as bytes or, for a visual plan, separately generated options, with notes for a headless design (a function plan takes notes with bytes null, never an image). expectedLatest defaults to the plan's latest version and is refused when it differs, and a revises image binds only when it is found in the stored version, otherwise the design is stored without a revision.

examples.prompt: Plan how a planning write is validated and committed.
examples.notes: Each request is checked, then written as one commit on the checked-out branch.

examples.prompt: Describe the read-only planning queries and what each returns.
examples.notes: Each read takes a revision and returns the plans and designs that revision holds.

inputs.name: openPlanThread.context
inputs.description: The planning context whose api reads the plan and opens the thread; root is not used.

inputs.name: openPlanThread.draft
inputs.description: The entity and its image anchor, where version, imageSha256, state, viewport and region are all null for an unanchored thread and option names the option holding the image. An anchored image must belong to that version, its state and viewport must match the draft's (they are checked, not stored), and a region must lie within the image with positive width and height.

inputs.name: approvePlanDesign.context
inputs.description: The planning context whose api reads the plan and records the approval; root is not used.

inputs.name: approvePlanDesign.draft
inputs.description: The entity, the design version (which must be the latest), the selected image hashes, the contract hash and, for a version with options, the option. Each hash must name one image of that version or of the chosen option, the contract hash must equal the latest contract hash, and the notes hash comes from the version rather than the draft.

outputs.name: reviewer
outputs.description: The local author identity, a person named Local reviewer, that plans and threads are authored under and whose name approvals record.

outputs.name: planningWrites
outputs.description: A promise for the new plan's record, read back after the commit: its id is the singular category and slug joined by a dot, its path is src/ followed by the plural category and the slug, its lifecycle is draft, and it has no versions or threads. Its contract holds the proposed inputs, outputs and errors, with empty lists where none were proposed.

examples.title: Planning writes
examples.goal: Adapts desktop planning requests into stored plans.

examples.title: Evidence grid
examples.goal: Shows the recorded captures of a unit side by side.

outputs.name: ensurePlan
outputs.description: A promise for the unit's plan record: the existing plan read at HEAD with its designs and threads, or a new draft seeded from the unit with no versions or threads. A new draft's contract keeps the unit's inputs and outputs as written, and its errors are shown as {name, type: 'error'} entries.

examples.title: Write plans, designs and approvals
examples.goal: Adapts desktop planning requests into stored plans, design versions, image threads and approvals.

examples.title: Evidence grid
examples.goal: Shows the recorded captures of a unit side by side.

versions.prompt: Show the recorded captures as a three-column grid.

outputs.name: addPlanDesign
outputs.description: A promise for the design version just added, read back with its plan: its version is the next in sequence (such as v002), its commit is the commit that added it, and its images are one PNG, one per option, or none for a notes-only design. Its approval is null for a new version, and options and revises appear only when the design has them.

examples.prompt: Plan how a planning write is validated and committed.
examples.notes: Each request is checked, then written as one commit on the checked-out branch.

examples.prompt: Make the evidence grid show the recorded captures in three columns.

outputs.name: openPlanThread
outputs.description: A promise for the new thread's summary: its id, its pin (the next number on the unit), its anchor's version, image hash, state, viewport and region (all null when unanchored), and its option when the image has one. messageCount is 0 because this operation writes no first message.

outputs.name: approvePlanDesign
outputs.description: A promise for the saved approval summary: its id, the approved version, the image hashes it binds, its contract hash and approval time, with option for a version with options. current is true when it is returned, because the approval binds the latest version.

errors.name: Invalid plan, thread, approval, or change write
errors.description: Thrown by planningWrites for a title with no letters or numbers, by openPlanThread for an image anchor missing from the given version or a state or viewport that differs from the image, and by approvePlanDesign for an unknown version or images that do not match it. Every operation also rejects with the planning package's Error when a planning API call or a follow-up read fails.

errors.name: PlanningWriteError
errors.description: Thrown for an unknown design version ('Unknown design version.') or for images that do not match the version or option ('Approval images do not match the version.').
